newsitem.title: USA: DT Industries to offer five mln shares.
newsitem.headline: DT Industries to offer five mln shares.

text.p: DT Industries Inc said Tuesday it would offer five million common shares at $34.50 each in simultaneous offers in the United States and overseas.
About 2.8 million of the shares are being offered by private stockholders, and the company will not receive any of the proceeds from their sale.
The other 2.2 million shares are owned by the company, which will use the proceeds from their sale to reduce corporate debt.
The company makes automated production equipment. Its shares closed unchanged at $34.50 on Tuesday.
